p2_b0.ocr: The study titled "Ferrari et al." conducted during the period 1983–1986 involved 127 patients (91 male/35 female) with a median age of 15 (range 5–43), classified as Enneking stage IIB, and took place in Austria. "Bacci et al." covered the years 1986–1993 with 29 patients (25 male/4 female), a median age of 46, also in stage IIB, conducted in Italy.

p2_b1.ocr: The "Edmonson et al." study from 1976–1980 had 38 patients (1 male/37 female), a median age of 17 (range 9–62), classified as stage IIB, in Austria. Research by "Gherlinzoni et al." from 1983–1988 included 355 patients (239 male/116 female) with no specified age or gender data, falling under stage IIA, in Italy. The "Goorin et al." study spanning 1976–1989 reported 74 patients (36 male/38 female) without median age data, classified as stage IIA, also in Austria.
